messages:
Lina (Design): Quick notes from the model-catalog sync: presets are buried, perf badges draw the eye away from names in compare, pinning doesn't persist. Short proposals below.

Omar (PM): Yep — saved views are underused. Can we surface a tiny presets toolbar above filters with an "Apply to compare" checkbox?

Dee (Eng): Backend note: persisting pins needs a small endpoint. We'll add GET/PUT /v1/user/pins and fallback to localStorage for anonymous users.

Kai (Frontend): Badge fix: remove shadow, muted bg, smaller font, right-align. CSS idea: `.perf-badge{ background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); border-radius:6px; font-size:11px; padding:3px 6px; box-shadow:none; }` Also add focus ring for keyboard users.

Maya (A11y): A11y: badges must have aria-labels (e.g. "98th pct latency: 220ms"). Presets toolbar should support arrow-key navigation and visible focus. Ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 if text is small.

Lina (Design): Microcopy: toolbar label "Views & presets"; pin tooltip "Pin version — saves this selection to your account"; toast: "Pinned version not in this compare."

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: experiment `catalog/presets-toolbar-v2` deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/catalog/compare

Omar (PM): I'll create the Jira with acceptance criteria: presets toolbar, apply-to-compare, badge de-emphasis, pin persistence, analytics events, a11y checklist. Target: next week.

Dee (Eng): :+1: We'll handle migration and retired-version soft-delete. Edge-case: do not auto-select pinned row if it's not in the current selection.

Kai (Frontend): :+1: I'll open a PR with styles, focus states, and keyboard tests.

Maya (A11y): :+1: I'll run NVDA/VoiceOver after staging deploy.

Lina (Design): Thanks everyone — updating Figma and will paste links in the ticket.
